test_cases.title: Start-Up Failure Alarm When Operational State Not Reached
test_cases.short_description: Alarm A010 if start-up exceeds 60 s
test_cases.source_tc: Genset System Availability after Power Cycle
preconditions: Means to delay control system start-up available (e.g. disconnected I/O module).

steps.action: Prevent the control system from reaching operational state ([TBD] method).
Switch off the 24 V control supply.
steps.expected: HMI and control system are switched off.

steps.action: Wait 10 s and switch on the 24 V control supply.
Wait 60 s after switching on the 24 V control supply.
steps.expected: Alarm A010 'Control system start-up failed' is displayed. HMI does not show 'System ready'.

open_points: Requirement does not define how a start-up failure can be provoked in the test setup.

test_cases.title: No Battery Warning in Normal Voltage Range
preconditions: Starter battery replaced by adjustable power supply.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V (normal class 22.0–28.8 V).

steps.expected: Neither W021 nor W022 is active.

test_cases.title: Low Battery Voltage Warning and Automatic Reset
test_cases.short_description: W021 below 22.0 V, cleared after 5 s normal
preconditions: Starter battery replaced by adjustable power supply.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V.
Reduce the battery supply voltage to 20.0 V (low class < 22.0 V).
steps.expected: Warning W021 'Low battery voltage' is displayed.

steps.action: Increase the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V and wait 5 s.

test_cases.title: High Battery Voltage Warning and Automatic Reset
test_cases.short_description: W022 above 28.8 V, cleared after 5 s normal
preconditions: Starter battery replaced by adjustable power supply.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V.
Increase the battery supply voltage to 30.0 V (high class > 28.8 V).
steps.expected: Warning W022 'High battery voltage' is displayed.

steps.action: Reduce the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V and wait 5 s.

test_cases.title: Battery Voltage Warning Thresholds at Range Boundaries
test_cases.short_description: Warning behaviour at 22.0 V and 28.8 V
preconditions: Starter battery replaced by adjustable power supply with [TBD] V resolution.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 22.0 V.
Reduce the battery supply voltage to 22.0 V minus [TBD] V.
steps.expected: Warning W021 'Low battery voltage' is displayed.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 28.8 V and wait 5 s.
Increase the battery supply voltage to 28.8 V plus [TBD] V.
steps.expected: Warning W022 'High battery voltage' is displayed.

steps.action: Set the battery supply voltage to 25.4 V and wait 4 s.

open_points: Measurement resolution / tolerance of the voltage thresholds is not specified.
